_schema_notes: document_title (not document_id) identifies the source chapter — resolved to the current Document.id at eval time via evaluation/common.py, since re-ingestion assigns a fresh UUID every run.

relevant_chunks entries are {chunk_type, number} pairs (not raw parent_index integers) — resolved to the current DocumentParentChunk.parent_index at eval time, since parent_index is assignment-order-dependent and would go stale across re-ingests. See evaluation/common.py:resolve_chunk_ref.

expected_ingestion_gap: true marks queries deliberately targeting content known to be dropped/overwritten by the unnumbered Exemple/Remarque collision bug in task.py (see code review). These should FAIL to resolve until that bug is fixed and the chapter is re-ingested — validate_dataset.py reports them separately rather than as dataset errors.

content_snippet (optional) is a short verbatim excerpt used as an extra sanity check that the resolved parent's content is actually the intended passage, not just a coincidentally-matching (chunk_type, number).
document_title now lives on each question (not top-level) — the dataset spans multiple chapters/documents.

questions.query: Pourquoi le polynôme caractéristique de l'endomorphisme induit sur un sous-espace stable divise-t-il celui de l'endomorphisme complet, et comment cela se traduit-il sur la matrice par blocs ?
questions.notes: Requires combining the block-triangular matrix form of stability (Corollaire 3) with the divisibility result for the induced characteristic polynomial (Proposition 33) — a single chunk answers only half the question.

questions.notes: Requires combining Théorème 60 (diagonalizability via a split-simple annihilating polynomial) with Corollaire 61 (the induced endomorphism inherits it).
